text:
Anya: Quick sync — deciding cuts for the next console sprint on observability. We have 4 candidate surfaces: dashboards (new templates + KPI widgets), tracing hooks (server-side span capture + client SDK), cost breakdown (cost-by-route + token-level cost), and error analytics (hotspots + sample payloads). Customers asked loudly for cost-by-route + error hotspots. Need a prioritized ship plan by EOD.

Mike: Thanks. Do we have data on complexity? I think cost-by-route is medium if we piggyback on existing billing events. Tracing hooks are high effort (backend + SDK). Dashboards could be small if we reuse tile components.

Serena: Customer asks from two accounts: (1) fintech customer wants "cost by endpoint" surfaced in console and an export. (2) marketplace wants error hotspots grouped by model+prompt. Both value quick sampling rather than full retention.

Kaushik: Constraints: Dedicated customers need private deploy compatibility (no outbound sampling). Also SLO: any tracing hook must not add >2ms p99 tail. That rules out synchronous span enrichers in critical path.

Eva: Proposed cuts: A) Ship "cost-by-route" tile (KPI + CSV export) in sprint 1 — low risk. B) Error hotspots UI backed by sampled logs (1% sampling, linked to trace IDs) in sprint 1. C) Tracing hooks (SDK + server hook) deferred to sprint 2 as opt-in beta. D) Dashboard templates: MVP with 3 tiles (cost, errors, latency) — ship with A/B. Acceptance criteria in PRD: feature flag, CSV export, sample rate configurable, perf tests showing <2ms overhead.

Mike: +1 to Eva. A couple of follow-ups: how will cost-by-route compute? We can either: 1) attribute from routing metadata (cheap) or 2) infer from logs (more accurate). Leaning to route metadata for MVP.

Serena: For error hotspots, customers want grouping by root-cause labels (model, prompt family, client). We should include a quick mapping table in the UI so CS can annotate.

Kaushik: Also note infra cost — storing sampled traces for error analytics needs retention policy. Suggest 7-day default and 30-day premium.

Anya: Good callouts. Action items: Mike + Kaushik to draft technical approach for cost attribution by noon. Serena to collect two customer examples and expected export schemas. Eva to write PRD acceptance checklist and gating. I'll consolidate and post to board.

Mike: For the technical approach, sketch in the channel:
```
Option A: route-metadata -> attribute in query pipeline (fast, ~2 dev days)
Option B: log-join attribution -> joins on request_id (accurate, ~6 dev days + infra)
```
I'll drop pros/cons in a thread.

deploy-bot: CI passed — branch observability/cost-tile-tests (build 4872). :white_check_mark:

Eva: If we cut tracing hooks to sprint 2, we should ship a telemetry hook stub in sprint 1 so SDK teams can start integrating. Minimal: header propagation + trace id in logs (opt-in flag).

Anya: Agree. Final ask: when you post the technical approach, mark any blockers (security, infra, legal). We'll decide cuts at 3pm sync. :thumbsup:

Serena: I'll upload the two customer export samples to the ticket and ping CS.

Kaushik: Noted. I'll include perf targets for the acceptance checklist.

Mike: Ok, drafting now.

Anya: Thanks everyone — will compile before 3pm and set the sprint commitments. :pray:
